column3: Description
Doing an amazing job training, building, encouraging and being flexible with the training and development of new team member Jonathan Flores
Doing an amazing job training, building, encouraging and being flexible with the training and development of new team member Jonathan Flores

Kierra has been instrumental in keeping our team up to date on training.  She is always supportive and helps in many ways outside of our required training documents.  Some days you can easily find her in production helping to throw, rework, or helping with our packaging department.  She is a great addition to the team and someone that we can always rely on.  Thank you Kierra for all you do to support our team.  - April Hannah & Frigo 4 Florence

Bruce has gone above and beyond in helping to grow the team and continues to provide excellent mentoring and training to the other clerks as we build the Florence MRO department to the level it should be.  He is always there for assisting and helping out all demands and requests that come his way. Thank you Bruce for all you do!

Brad recently volunteered to cover a scheduled position outside of his normal duties and shift during a fellow workers time of need.  This greatly helped out the department allowing for continuity and coverage across all shifts.  Thank you Brad for going the extra mile to help out the team - It is greatly appreciated.

Gabrielle has provided very valuable training and guidance to our newest clerk over the past week.  She has demonstrated very high level leadership skills and sharp, clear, and focused communication for the team.  The efforts put forth during this time are greatly appreciated and shows how awesome  she is at what she does.  Thank you Gabrielle for the teamwork!

I would like to recognize Jannett Lopez for the outstanding teamwork and responsiveness she demonstrated on a critical new innovation item requiring sensory evaluation. Jannett quickly took ownership, organized an expedited sensory and partnered effectively across departments to keep things moving under a tight timeline. Her proactive approach played a key role in ensuring we met customer demand without disruption.

Adlai has been very communicative and helpful with requests. I have worked with Adlai on a few graphic projects and he has always offered guidance and resources as needed, and within time restrictions. Thankful for his help with the La Cocina project.

Jason has been instrumental in providing the images for the new La Cocina static images. I know he has a lot of other projects going on but he jumped in to help. This is greatly appreciated and a perfect example of Teamwork.
Josh contributed to the Denison Line 1 Delkor Secondary Packaging start up providing outstanding evaluation of machine safety.  He added guarding, inspected, tested, and provided LOTO documentation.

Huge thanks to Rena! As a core project team member, Rena was instrumental in the successful relaunch of the ElMonterey.com website. To ensure the project launched on-time, Rena dedicated an entire weekend to review 60+ pages of web content: Nutrition Facts, Ingredients Statement, Marketing Copy, Product Imagery. Thank You!
Jesse was tremendously helpful providing existing asset information that needed to be changed for three projects I manage.  Thank you, Jesse!

Rena took on the daunting task of ensuring the refresh of the ElMonterey.com website was compliant - not just from a Regulatory compliance standpoint, but also cleaning up spelling and typographical errors.   Forty-six pages of detailed material were reviewed in only a few days, allowing Ruiz to put its' best foot forward in the marketplace.   Spectacular job!

Ulyssa joined Ruiz Foods just 10 days ago and was tasked with getting up to speed and publishing our new innovation items on the 1WorldSyn platform. Time was ticking away where it could negatively effect new business with Kroger and Ahold, USA. Today, we successfully published these items and our potential new business has been saved. This was a huge accomplishment. So glad to have Ulyssa on our team!

I just want to take a moment and send this Praise to Mike for being an outstanding partner and a true asset to the IT team. From day one, he made my onboarding seamless by ensuring all my software, laptop, and phone setup were handled quickly and thoughtfully. He is always approachable, highly responsive, and consistently willing to go the extra mile - whether that means walking over to my desk to help troubleshoot or jumping in to assist without hesitation. His collaborative mindset and genuine desire to help make working with him a great experience.  Thank you for always being there and making a difference.
Gus always goes above and beyond for the team. He is always eager to learn new things, and is always ready to help out when needed. Thank you, Gus, for everything you do for the CRM team!

Adlai is a great partner. Whenever I reach out to him he is friendly and provides the information or resources needed. He has connected me with the right people at the right time and it is a pleasure to work with him. Most recently Radhika reached out to him for a logo to better fit the new La Cocina and he quickly provided it for us. Thank you, Adlai.

As a person who is behind the times when it comes to completely understanding the computer, I find myself getting frustrated due to not having learned many of the functions our work computers deliver for us. It is on those days that I call the person who has always been willing to take my calls, hear my frustration, adjust my travel needs for various countries I am traveling to and other needs I have. His name is Isauro Villarreal and I could never share my deep appreciation for all the calls Isauro has fielded from me over the past 14 years. 
In my earliest days with Ruiz Foods, Isauro and I met and due to my needed help, Isauro has always been there for me. No mater what day, what time, what question, anything.
Isauro....Thank you for making my days at Ruiz Foods enjoyable in part due to all your support with my IT and tech support.

I have had the pleasure of working on the same team as Juan for over 12 years.
During this time, Juan and I have worked on various projects: Sales planning, Budgets, Annual sales plans. In all of these examples, the requirements for delivering a solid plan is to have someone who can build and manage a spreadsheet that contains many cells of data. You can only imagine the tremendous amounts of data that each contain.
On top of all this data, the successful person managing this, must also be comfortable collecting and inputting all this data, while collaborating with the broad sales team to collect it.
This brings me to why Juan Guzman is a valuable team member of our Retail Sales team.
Juan is the individual who builds, collects, manages, collaborates all this data.
Juan does this with skill and professionalism with serving the team he works with.
Juan.....Thank you for all you do to support the West Retail team as well as the broader team in helping to mange our business.

Paul's name has become synonymous with problem solving. He exhibits exceptional knowledge of the M3 system and seems always willing to help fix issues that crop up.  I have made comments to my team mates and they have responded in kind that Paul is the "go to" person when it comes to fixing system messes. When dealing with Paul it is always a pleasure and never a waste of time. If he can't provide an answer then he always seems to know who to contact, that can provide support. . He should be officially recognized.  Thanks.

Jenny manages Kroger, our largest grocery customer for the Retail Sales team.
In that capacity, she has the responsibility of overseeing 22 individual Kroger Divisions, an 84.51 consumer platform, a Levantee deduction platform and several other programs that are relevant for Kroger. Suffice to say, Kroger is a complex customer. 
As the leader of the Kroger business, Jenny plays a critical role in the West team delivering our monthly volume forecast. With the available tools, she consistently delivers a 99% accurate forecast for our team. This insures that the business is fully prepared to deliver the needed inventory to satisfy our customers. 
Additionally, during Jenny's tenure of managing our Kroger business, Kroger sales volumes have grown by 23%.....when compared to category growth, this is a great achievement. 
Jenny is a solid team mate for the team.
Jenny....Thank you for delivering outstanding results for our West team and for being a solid contributor to our teams success.

Every great team is a collection of talented and dedicated people driven to success.
In that capacity, every individual plays a role on the team to help deliver the result.
Kelli Gana is part of the Retail Sales team and supports us as an administrator for HR.
Kelli's work in supporting the team with any administrative needs, provides a key role that allows the team to focus on our customers.
Kelli's support with coordinating meetings, Teams Calls, Team events, Vacation approvals and just about everything our team needs is critical to us all.
Kelli....Thank you for all your support of our team and managing our administrative needs on a daily bases.

Among Jurea's many roles, she supports the Retail team by providing insight on our financials. 
Each month, Jurea pulls together the financial numbers and then reviews them with the team.
Jurea has a talent in how she educates the team with the numbers. She takes them through all the metrics and then provides the insight as to what is driving those results. She takes whatever time is needed to explain the background and all details. This process helps to make our sales people stronger in understanding what is driving the profit margins we are seeing. This makes our team better and able to make better decisions as they manage our customers.
Jurea, Thank you for all your support of the Retail Sales team and for educating us on the financial metrics that drive our results.

Marie Cortez is a model for people who want to strive for constant improvement by learning more.
Marie is a member of the West Retail team in the capacity of a Retail Business Administrator.
I have had the pleasure of working on the same team as Marie for close to four years.
During this time, one constant has stuck with me about Marie. She is always wanting to understand more, learn more, expand her knowledge more.
A recent example of this came as we identified a void on our West team for support backup on our Kroger team, assisting with processing Deductions and Contracts. With out hesitation, Marie raised her hand and offered her support......"I'll help, Kevin".....this did not surprise me.
Marie has begun the process of learning from one of our best, Millie Brees. Marie and Millie are working together to transfer some knowledge and insight to help make our team better.
Thank you, Marie for always looking to support the needs of our team and raising your hand to make us a better team.

I would like to take a moment to recognize Justine McKinley, Learning & Development Supervisor for her outstanding leadership, hard work, can-do attitude, and dedication. Justine has gone above and beyond in assisting and coordinating training efforts for the Dinuba and Vernon facilities. Her commitment, attention to detail, and proactive approach have played a key role in strengthening our training programs. As a result of their efforts, both facilities have shown measurable improvement in training records and compliance. 

Thank you, Justine, for your leadership, teamwork, and commitment to excellence. Your hard work has not gone unnoticed and is truly appreciated.
test praise

Kelli has gone above and beyond helping the retail marketing team with PO requests and processing. She jumped in head first to learn the process and has been instrumental in educating the marketing team on the process and helping expand our expertise. Kelli has exemplified what teamwork is and we're fortunate to have her on the team.

I want to give praise to Lori for jumping in and helping us solve a time-sensitive customer issue. When unexpected demand meant we had to adjust our original shipping plan, she used her deep knowledge of our network to quickly find a alternative warehouse option. Because she understands our distribution footprint so well, we were able to pivot and still get the customer their items in time for their promotion. I really appreciate her flexibility, urgency, and willingness to find a solution. It made a difference.

Octavio (Tavo) as we call him, is a team member of the CSR team.
In that capacity, Tavo supports our customers by insuring their orders are both accurate and delivered as soon as we can get it to them.
Recently, Tavo took on the additional role of supporting the West retail team in the capacity of our re-entry in the Canada marketplace.
Tavo is part of our "Team" and contributes to all facets tied to customer service for our customers. 
As we have entered been received back into Canada, the customers were skeptical of our ability to deliver against their expectations. We knew we had to exceed them in order to gain back their respect. Tavo took this as a challenge and has delivered great customer satisfaction enabling us to successfully gain back their support and willingness to put our products back on the shelf.
Tavo....thank you for all the work and results you have delivered, allowing us to gain the confidence of our Canada customers.

Greg Malton has been managing our Kroger analytics relationship with 84.51 since Day1.
We need look no farther then how Kroger has performed over the past 13 years to see the effect Greg has had on that piece of business.
In 2012, Kroger represented about $22M in sales for us.
In 2026, Kroger will deliver close to $90M in sales for us.
Why has this happened speaks directly to the affect Greg has had on the business.
84.51 is Kroger's consumer facing analytics showcasing what Kroger customers buy, when they buy and how often. Greg's role is to help us identify what we can bring Kroger to deliver sales growth for our business. 
Greg has always stayed updated with all the available insight to help us improve at Kroger.
The insight he pulls together has helped us build "win-win" scenarios for us with Kroger.
Greg....thank you for all your contributions to the success of our business relationship with Kroger.

Cathy Haynes learned a valuable lesson at an early age.
"Do your best, all the time"
That lesson has carried her to where she resides today as a RBA working on the West Retail team.
Cathy works along side our retail sales team supporting them in the capacity of creating contracts, working deductions to insure they are accurate and reflective of our trade spend.
Cathy has been with Ruiz Foods for just under 14 years and has been instrumental in creating the role that she and our many other RBA's do so well on an everyday bases.
Cathy along with Wendy Tucker were asked to create a job manual for the RBA position. I had the opportunity to witness greatness as the two of them outlined all the details for every aspect of the role of being an RBA at Ruiz Foods. To say I was impressed, would be an understatement. The detail with which this manual was created was exceptional and will help future RBA's to learn this role much easier.
She is a "go to" person when insight is needed and always has a way to resolve the challenge your dealing with.
Cathy; thank you for all your work on the RBA manual that you built and for all the work you do to keep our West customers happy with our performance.

Laurie - thank you for not letting go of the GFI deduction issue.  You stayed in the game and won the battle.  You saved the company close to $30,000.
Thank you for not giving up!
Darlene

I want to give a huge thank-you to Maritza for her consistent support of the Training Tracking Application. Maritza has always been a champion of this app - always encouraging the Dinuba team to learn and adopt the application, supporting IT with requests for application testing, and proactively alerting us to issues that we need to address. Maritza's dedication, ownership mindset, and willingness to support both the system and the people using it make an incredible impact on our overall training success. Thank you Maritza!!!

Jannett went the extra mile to ensure Frisco received samples needed for the Quality Summit. The Texas storms resulted in lost or delayed packages and samples had to be resent multiple times. Jannett utilized the transportation team to ship backup samples to Denison and ensure we had everything we needed for the Quality Summit.

If anyone on the Retail Sales team needs to get any information, find out something from the Marketing team, get access to sales decks, inventory questions, gather insight about product specs or numerous other information.....there is one person they go to and that is 
Erin "Fabulous" Bugni.
Erin is the "go to person" for all aspects tied to insight for the Retail team.
She handles this busy role with grace and true professionalism.
She treats the team as if they were her own kids and insures they know what is going on and supports all their needs.
Erin....on behalf of the entire Retail Sales team, thank you for all you do to support all our needs in order to allow us to focus on our jobs.
You are truly "Fabulous"

Robin joined the West retail sales team after an extensive search in order to help support our team in the CCR region (Central California region).
In this short timeframe, Robin has made some significant contributions to our team.
Most notably, she teamed with Marie Cortez and Cathy Yochem to secure a large repay from one of our West customers in the amount of $25K.....great work on this.
Robin has been asked to also help support our Kroger business in order to expand our teams  knowledge of the challenging Kroger proprietary deduction system.....she has taken on this ask with vigor and enthusiasm.
Robin keeps her deduction balance well under the targets for the West team.
Robin....Thanks for all your contributions that have helped our West team and CCR region deliver our solid results.

In her capacity as the Central Region Manager for the Retail Sales Team, Cathy manages our most complex region on our West team. What makes this region so complex is the large number of accounts she manages as well the significant amount of contacts she must maintain in order to do her job successfully.
One of her accounts is Grocery Outlet and one year ago, we had some challenges dealing with loss of promotional activity and key periods to sell product.
Cathy invested a significant amount of time, energy, focus and creativity to create a program and delivered a "win/win" to the customer that was accepted. Since that program was accepted, Cathy has seen her business achieve a new level of volume for this account.
Cathy; congratulations on what you have done to show Grocery Outlet that we can help them deliver great results for their category by using El Monterey to do that......Great work!

Carin always goes above and beyond to help answer questions and help out where needed. She is a great advocate for our office culture and always has Ruiz Foods best interest in mind. She is always exemplifying our core values.

Darryl has established a new threshold for securing display performance.
He has earned trust with his customers by sharing data and utilizing strong negotiation skills to secure those displays.
Additionally, he has worked with his customers to identify key events to drive the Snack category results and thus allowing for El Monterey to see some significant wins during those windows.
Darryl, congrats on the continued development of the Northwest region results!

Millie came back to work 18 months ago after retiring from Ruiz Foods the first time.
She is responsible for managing our Trade and Deductions for our Kroger business.
In her role, Millie deals with Kroger's proprietary system, Levante, which is how Kroger manages deductions and processes them for their vendors.
Millie is a "Professional" funds administrator and runs her business at a high level.
Keeping our deductions to a minimum allows us to invest our Trade to drive sales for Ruiz Foods and Kroger.
Millie, Thank you for what you do to keep the Kroger deductions to a minimum allowing us to secure improved results with those funds.

In Dan's capacity as the Region Manager for the South Central region, he has full responsibility for two of our largest customers; HEB and WinCo.
The results that those two customers have delivered for our West business is significant.
Dan's work with WinCo has delivered an improved promotional calendar and display performance vs. last year. That plan has delivered a +8% volume increase vs. last year.
At HEB, Dan's work with our Broker partner and the HEB category manager have delivered new distribution on shelf (Breakfast and Snacks). That new distribution has delivered a +10% volume increase vs. last years results.
Congrats to Dan for delivering great results for his region and helping the West team to deliver our volume commitments for the business.

I would like to recognize and thank Michael for his consistent support and professionalism. He is extremely knowledgeable, always responsive, and approach every request with respect and patience. His willingness to help and his positive attitude make a real difference in keeping our office running smoothly and ensuring the team feels supported. I truly appreciate his dedication and the high level of service he provides every day.

Kristi supports our Retail team in the area of Data analytics.
In this capacity, she provides consumption insight for our customers in the various categories we participate in. 
Much of this work is behind the scenes and requires collaboration with the sales team. 
Kristi is a solid contributor to the success our West team is seeing, as she helps to identify opportunities where we can improve our customers and our business.
Kristi; thank you for all you do to support our Retail team.

Amber has offered to add the responsibility of supporting our re-entry into Canada retail.
By adding this responsibility, she is tasked with supporting our Broker partner with monitoring, clearing and consulting on all aspects of Funds administration. 
Our re-entry to Canada has been successful and one of our key reasons is due to the extra effort and support that Amber Evans has done for us.
Thanks for all you are doing for our team, Amber.

This praise is for the Dinuba Ops team, qa group & R&D. On 1/23/26 we had a product that was not running very well on the line. The teams worked extremely quickly to come up with a test plan and ran a non saleable test a couple hours later in the middle of the day to produce product that was a vast improvement to the original. It took a lot of hustle to make it all happen.

Chanda is providing impactful work supporting the Retail Sales BU by sharing insights for customer calls. Chanda is diligent in finding solutions in her role as a Pricing Manager. Feedback from the sales team on the product(s) she delivers is positive and shows results. Thank you Chanda for all of your hard work!

Erin "Houdini" Bugni may not pull rabbits from hats, but she can make new item package flats appear anywhere! Two different retailer requests in one week for Mas Bold package flats when there were none available, and Erin delivered. This is one more example of Erin's resourcefulness and determination to help our sales team deliver. Thank you Erin!
I want to thank Callie for her continued help on eComm and asset needs for the Dollar Channel. Callie makes time for me, always follows up and delivers no matter the timeline. Thank you Callie!
I want to thank Kelli for stepping up and helping to keep the office running smoothly as we transition to a new EA.  She is always pleasant and eager to help wherever she can.  Thanks, Kelli.

David Pennington, Director of Food Safety and Quality, has done an outstanding job to manage through many complex regulatory events. In addition, under David’s leadership, all Ruiz manufacturing plants have gained BRCGS certification, an outstanding achievement!
David, I appreciate your dedication and leadership to support the plants and ensure food safety is never compromised.

Rena Lopez, Director of Regulatory and Consumer Affairs, is a recognized expert in regulatory affairs and labeling. Her dedication to professional growth is notable; she earned a Master of Science in Regulatory Affairs a few short years ago – an impressive achievement completed while working full-time and managing a household.  I value Rena’s continuous improvement efforts to improve processes and impact the bottom line. 
Rena, thank you for being an exceptional leader and a source of reliable guidance and support.

Billie Shamblin, who oversees Supplier Management within the Food safety and Quality team, led a significant cross-functional initiative over the past year. This project successfully developed a new internal audit program and reporting systems designed to serve all Ruiz manufacturing locations, enhancing their preparation for the BRCGS audits. 
Billie, thank you for your outstanding diligence, patience, and willingness to support the team and go the extra mile!

John Velasco has stepped into the role of Hygienic Design Specialist. Throughout the past year, he has diligently participated in equipment reviews, ensuring sanitary design prior to purchase to enhance the food safety of our processes. John has shown significant passion and zeal for this role, continuously working to improve the program and focus on educating our teams. 
John, thank you for your commitment and for always putting in 100+ percent!

Leif Edon and the Quality Systems team within the Food Safety and Quality department have successfully completed a complex value stream map of our quality processes over the past few months. This impressive, albeit laborious, work provides a crucial tool that will support future program development. Thank you, Leif, for your exceptional leadership and dedication to Ruiz Foods.

Larry and his team work on 3rd shift (graves). 

At 10 am last  Thursday, I reached out to Larry and asked him to return to the plant with some of his team to clean line 1 and have it ready to run on swing shift.  Larry and his team jumped in and met the challenge.   

I am extremely grateful for Larry's team and his Leadership. 

This is just one example of the outstanding job they do each night (and sometimes days!!)

They make a huge difference for Ruiz !!  This performance is only possible because of Larry's commitment and leadership.  

Thank You Larry!!

The November Publix Review combined three categories. This required building custom databases and a strategic analysis of sales trends. Andrea spent many hours to accomplish this and she was extremely focused to deliver the best possible outcome for Ruiz Foods and Publix. Her efforts are adding tremendous value to our partnership with Publix.

Chanda ran a Productivity Report for the Publix November Category Review. Some of the data was not favorable to Ruiz Foods and it was a challenge to effectively apply the analysis. We talked a few times and decided to sleep on it. The next day Chanda created a table ranking the Efficiency Index of Snacks & Dinner/Entree brands.
